sources.entry: OpenBudgeteer - Budgeting app based on the Bucket Budgeting Principle. AGPL-3.0 Docker/C#

summary.one_liner: OpenBudgeteer is a self-hostable budgeting app built on the Bucket Budgeting Principle, with a .NET core and a Blazor Server front end.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes OpenBudgeteer as a budgeting app based on the Bucket Budgeting Principle and inspired by YNAB and Buckets. The core is written in .NET using the MVVM pattern, and the front end is Blazor Server. The README points to separate documentation covering installation, setup and usage, and to a Quick Start for running it with Docker and MariaDB. The README body itself is short and does not list specific features in detail. Screenshots are referenced but not included in the text provided.
how_to_run: See the Quick Start section in the README for running with Docker and MariaDB
Full installation and setup instructions are in the separate Documentation referenced by the README
notable: Based on the Bucket Budgeting Principle
Blazor Server front end on a .NET core
caveats: Some documentation sections are still marked as work in progress
README gives little detail on features; full setup is in external documentation
